"""Launch the one original frozen-parent cache worker after actual data inspection."""
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v1';plan=read(root/'data-plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert not (root/'data-cache-launch-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'data-cache.claim').exists()
assert '288 passed in 4.58s' in (repo/'.cache/v168-data-CPU-regression-v1.log').read_text()
view=read(root/'data-actual-viewing-v1.json');assert view['status']=='actually-viewed-all-six-data-boards-at-original-detail'
assert ref(view['inspection']['path'])==view['inspection']
work=Path(plan['work']);env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=':'.join(str(work/p) for p in ['scripts','src']),
 OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
worker=read(root/'data-worker-source-v1.json')['worker'];assert ref(worker['path'])==worker
with (root/'data-cache-v1.log').open('x') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-P',worker['path'],str(root),'cache'],cwd=repo,env=env,
  stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'data-cache-launch-v1.json',{'status':'original-worker-launched-no-retry','owner':owner,
 'plan':ref(root/'data-plan-v1.json'),'worker':worker,'actual_viewing':ref(root/'data-actual-viewing-v1.json'),
 'CPU_tests':{'passed':288,'seconds':4.58,'log':ref(repo/'.cache/v168-data-CPU-regression-v1.log')},
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(owner,flush=True)
